speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated Clostridium difficile infection. The clinical presentation of acute watery diarrhea, abdominal cramping, and recent levofloxacin use is highly specific for C. diff, despite the unspecified toxin result in the initial unverified data. Please confirm if you have a history of prior C. difficile infections or recent hospitalizations.
